VH=fwprobeh0
VN=fwproben0

cleanup() { kill "${P8080:-}" "${P9090:-}" "${P18081:-}" 2>/dev/null || true; ip netns del "$NS" 2>/dev/null || true; ip link del "$VH" 2>/dev/null || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
ip netns add "$NS"
ip link add "$VH" type veth peer name "$VN"
ip link set "$VN" netns "$NS"
ip addr add 198.18.0.1/30 dev "$VH"
ip link set "$VH" up
ip netns exec "$NS" ip link set lo up
ip netns exec "$NS" ip addr add 198.18.0.2/30 dev "$VN"

    printf 'tcp/%s ACCEPTED\n' "$p"

    printf 'tcp/%s REJECTED_OR_DROPPED\n' "$p"

cleanup

ip netns list | grep "^${NS}[[:space:]]" && exit 1 || true
ip link show "$VH" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 1 || true
